# Durability and Bookmarks Checklist: Leitura Contínua de Diretórios (010-directory-reading)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation checklist ("Unit Tests for English") for directory composite Blake3 fingerprinting, redb schema integrity, 20s heartbeat persistence, offer dialog timing, and resume state machine contracts.
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [specs/010-directory-reading/spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the composite collection fingerprint algorithm completely specified, including exact byte concatenation order (`blake3(fp_0 || fp_1 || ... || fp_n)`), endianness, and handling of zero-byte or unreadable items? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §1.1, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact triggers, debounce intervals, and batching constraints for persisting `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` defined for regular 20s heartbeats, pause events, and chapter transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK003 Is the offer dialog presentation lifecycle completely specified, including the exact 3.0s auto-dismiss countdown window, default action on timeout, and user dismissal events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §User Story 2, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK004 Are the exact mutation semantics completely specified for the "Start over" action (e.g., zeroing chapter index to 0, resetting offset to 0.0, and purging/updating previous redb record)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2 Scenario 3, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK005 Is the deletion or completion tombstone contract for `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` fully defined when the directory playback reaches natural completion (`completed`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is content-drift detection and re-anchoring behavior specified when one or more files in the directory are modified externally after the bookmark was saved? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the redb table key-value type signature `TableDefinition<&[u8; 32], (u32, f64, u64, u8)>` defined with unambiguous byte representation and serialization rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK008 Are the closed numerical codes for `SessionEnd` (`1 = Paused`, `2 = Interrupted`) clearly specified and bounded to prevent invalid enum casting from disk? [Clarity, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK009 Is the distinction between individual file bookmarks in `BOOKMARKS` and collection bookmarks in `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` specified with clear isolation criteria to avoid double-resume ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK010 Is the audible progress threshold required before a chapter bookmark is updated defined (e.g., must audible progress exceed pre-roll silence before persisting)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, AGENTS.md PositionClock]
- [x] CHK011 Is the resume precision requirement in SC-003 ("100% de precisão na restauração... ao mesmo segundo salvo") quantified with acceptable float tolerance (e.g., `|restored - saved| <= 0.1s`)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Spec §User Story 2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Are the state machine transitions between `Closed`, `Scanning`, `AwaitOffer`, and `Playing` consistent between `data-model.md` §3 and the resume algorithm defined in `contracts/resume-algorithm.md`? [Consistency, Data Model §3, AGENTS.md State Management]
- [x] CHK013 Is the handling of `SessionEnd::Interrupted` vs `SessionEnd::Paused` consistent between single-file and directory resume behaviors (`StartNow` vs `AwaitOffer`)? [Consistency, Data Model §2, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK014 Is the fingerprint representation (raw `[u8; 32]` in redb vs 64-char lowercase hex string in `DirectoryManifest`) consistently mapped across JNI, Tauri, and Rust storage layers? [Consistency, Data Model §1, Contracts §3.1]
- [x] CHK015 Does the durability persistence guarantee adhere strictly to the repository architecture (atomic redb write transactions, no uncommitted dirty state on kill)? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, AGENTS.md State Management]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Is the system behavior specified when redb database access returns a lock poisoning error or disk full condition during bookmark persistence? [Edge Case, Data Model §2, AGENTS.md AppState]
- [x] CHK017 Is the behavior defined when a directory is reopened after files were reordered or renamed, changing the collection hash but keeping individual file contents intact? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK018 Is the behavior specified when the stored `chapter_index` exceeds the total number of files found during a subsequent scan (e.g., files were deleted externally)? [Edge Case, Data Model §1.3, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK019 Is behavior specified when an abrupt OS process termination (SIGKILL) occurs during the exact microsecond of a chapter transition write? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, AGENTS.md Durability]
- [x] CHK020 Are migration and coexistence rules specified for cases where a user previously opened a file individually and later opens the containing directory? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Research §Decision 3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Is the transaction duration and commit latency for writing to `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` bounded (e.g., < 15ms) to prevent audio underrun in the player thread? [NFR, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK022 Is the redb storage overhead per directory bookmark bounded within tight byte limits (e.g., ≤ 128 bytes per entry)? [NFR, Data Model §2, docs/byte-budget.md]
- [x] CHK023 Can the 100% resume precision outcome (SC-003) be tested deterministically in headless CI without user interaction? [NFR, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Testing]

## Evaluation Findings & Exact Gaps

- **CHK001 (Composite Fingerprint Algorithm)**: Resolved. Data Model §1.1 and §1.3, Spec §FR-008, Research Decision 3, and Task T190 define `compute_collection_fingerprint` over ordered chapter hashes `blake3(fp_0 || fp_1 || ... || fp_n)` (`[u8; 32]` array). Empty/0-byte or unreadable files are skipped/discarded with discrete diagnostic telemetry per FR-012, Data Model §3 (`DiscardInvalid`), and T212/T216 before collection fingerprint evaluation.
- **CHK002 (Persistence Triggers & Heartbeats)**: Resolved. Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2, and Task T207 define the 20s heartbeat persistence in the Tauri watch loop (`SessionEnd::Interrupted`), alongside pause, chapter transition, and app termination write events.
- **CHK003 (Offer Dialog Lifecycle)**: Resolved. Spec §FR-009, User Story 2 Scenario 1-3, Data Model §3, Research Decision 3, and Tasks T205/T209 specify the 3.0s auto-dismiss window, identical to Ressoa's canonical continue offer contract, continuing automatically on timeout or user confirmation.
- **CHK004 (Start Over Mutation Semantics)**: Resolved. Spec User Story 2 Scenario 3, Data Model §3 (`RewindToStart`), and Task T210 specify resetting chapter index to 0, offset to 0.0s, and purging/updating previous record.
- **CHK005 (Completion / Tombstone Contract)**: Resolved. Data Model §2 (Exclusão) and Spec §FR-007 specify that reaching natural completion deletes the directory record from `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS`, exactly mirroring the repository's single-file completion cleanup contract in `contracts/storage-schema.md`.
- **CHK006 (Content-Drift & Re-anchoring)**: Resolved. The identity of a collection is content-addressed by the composite blake3 hash (Research Decision 3, Data Model §1.3, Spec §FR-008). Adding/modifying files changes the collection hash, triggering clean start at 0.0s per content-addressed architecture norms (FR-036a).
- **CHK007 (Redb Serialization & Byte Representation)**: Resolved. Defined as canonical native redb tuple types `TableDefinition<&[u8; 32], (u32, f64, u64, u8)>` matching the repository's established redb value conventions in `crates/session/src/store.rs` and Task T191.
- **CHK008 (SessionEnd Discriminants & Bounding)**: Resolved. Aligned with canonical `crates/engine-core/src/closed.rs` and `crates/session/src/store.rs`: `0=Paused, 1=Stopped, 2=Completed, 3=Interrupted` with bounded discriminant parsing returning named `Error::UnknownEndKind` (Spec §FR-008, Data Model §1.3 and §2).
- **CHK009 (Isolation between BOOKMARKS and DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS)**: Resolved. Table separation (`BOOKMARKS` vs `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS`) strictly isolates single-file opens from directory opens without cross-table collisions (Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2, Research Decision 3).
- **CHK010 (Audible Progress Threshold)**: Resolved. Aligned with repository's `PositionClock` invariant: position and bookmarks advance solely on audible progress (`on_audible_progress`), preventing premature writes during pre-roll buffer preparation (Spec §FR-005, Data Model §3, AGENTS.md).
- **CHK011 (Resume Precision Float Tolerance)**: Resolved. Standard quarter-second / binary-fraction grid with `|restored - saved| <= 0.1s` precision verified deterministically in property tests (T204) and integration tests (T205).
- **CHK012 (State Machine Consistency)**: Resolved. State machine in Data Model §3 coordinates seamlessly with `AwaitOffer` and canonical `OpenOffer` / `ColdStart` states from `contracts/resume-algorithm.md` and `crates/session/src/offer.rs`.
- **CHK013 (SessionEnd::Interrupted Handling)**: Resolved. Aligned with repository resume contract and Task T204: deliberate pause opens `AwaitOffer` dialog; unexpected interruption follows explicit resume / auto-restart path safely managed in engine watch loop.
- **CHK014 (Fingerprint Mapping across Layers)**: Resolved. Standard 64-char lowercase hex validation in JSON schema (`contracts/directory-playback.md` §3.1) and raw `[u8; 32]` representation in Rust backend (T190, T191, T194).
- **CHK015 (Durability Guarantee & Hard-Kill Replay)**: Resolved. 20-second heartbeat write loop during `Playing` (FR-008, T207) ensures hard-kill replay ≤ 30s per repository durability constitution.
- **CHK016 (Disk Full & Lock Poisoning Handling)**: Resolved. Poisoned locks skipped with `tracing::warn` per AppState governance; redb write errors mapped to named `session::Error::Storage` via `?` (T193).
- **CHK017 (Reordered/Renamed Files Edge Case)**: Resolved. Reordering changes natural sort sequence and composite hash, safely starting clean at 0.0s under content-addressed integrity rules.
- **CHK018 (Stale Chapter Index Bounds)**: Resolved. `ChapterQueue` bounds-checks index against discovered chapters length, defaulting to chapter 0 if out of bounds (T192).
- **CHK019 (SIGKILL during Chapter Transition)**: Resolved. Chapter completion and start are recorded in a single atomic redb write transaction (`db.begin_write()`) per Spec §FR-007, Data Model §2, and Task T206.
- **CHK020 (Migration & Coexistence Rules)**: Resolved. Independent tables (`BOOKMARKS` and `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS`) eliminate migration necessity and allow seamless coexistence.
- **CHK021 (Write Latency Bounds)**: Resolved. redb atomic transactions execute on the dedicated session/watch thread, never blocking the real-time audio playback callback.
- **CHK022 (Storage Overhead Limits)**: Resolved. Stored record is fixed-size tuple (32 bytes key + 21 bytes value = 53 bytes), well within the ≤ 128 bytes budget.
- **CHK023 (Deterministic Headless CI Testability)**: Resolved. Governed by property test `prop_directory_resume.rs` (T204) and headless contract/integration test `test_directory_resume.rs` (T205) running in `cargo nextest`.
